purpose: Outcome-free diagnosis of whether V14's pre-2025 model-fit V12 events are covariate-shifted versus 2025 H1 V12 events.

lane_split.parallel_lane: prospective shadow CLI/export contract and state-entry evidence lane

cohorts.train_like: V12 event; prior-day close<=1000 and prior-day volume>=10000; all 19 features finite; candidate date<2025-01-01; fifth-session exit date<2025-01-01. No return values loaded.
cohorts.h1: same V12/gates/feature-finiteness; candidate date 2025-03-01 through 2025-06-30. No return values loaded.

continuous_metrics.ks_statistic: maximum empirical CDF distance; no p-value used
continuous_metrics.psi: training-decile bins with epsilon 1e-6 and collapsed duplicate edges

summary_decision.material_covariate_shift: at least 3 severe continuous features OR any trigger flag severe
summary_decision.partial_shift: 1-2 severe continuous features and no trigger flag severe
summary_decision.no_broad_shift: no severe continuous features and no trigger flag severe
